summary: Two fixed-time signal timing variants of one four-leg car/pedestrian intersection. The independent variable is the signal plan: which approach receives the longer green and, coordinated to it, each crosswalk's walk interval. Both variants run from one common-random-number seed bank so the per-seed runs are paired.
controlled: control rules other than the signal plan
independent_variable: the fixed-time signal plan: the green split between the two approaches and the crosswalk walk intervals coordinated to it
